body.message:
When you confirmed the rates (6000 – July, 6500 – August, 7500 – September) at 14:06, there was no mention of any requirement to pay 50% of the last month’s rent in advance. This condition was introduced only afterward, and now, just a few days before my contract ends (22/07), you are asking me to accept a new term that was never part of our agreement.

I have paid every previous month on time without delay, and you already hold my security deposit as protection. I don’t think it’s fair to add this new condition at the last minute, especially when it wasn’t discussed during our negotiation.

I am ready to pay the July rent (6000 AED) today to confirm the extension. I kindly ask you to honor the rates as agreed, without the additional 50% advance requirement for the last month. If needed, we can revisit the last month’s payment terms closer to September.

Please confirm so I can proceed with the payment today.
